name: Curl Request
summary: Execute HTTP requests with curl — the transport most skills use to reach their APIs.
description:
Executes HTTP requests using `curl`. This is the transport layer most skills build on: a skill describes the endpoint, and `curl_request` makes the call.

Outbound URLs are checked against the `allowed_domains` list in `koris.json` by the security gate, and the tool is only offered to trusted senders.

Use only the parameters a skill explicitly requires — do not invent extra shell transformations.

params.name: url
params.description: URL to request. Keep values exactly as required by the skill.

params.name: data
params.description: Request body for POST/PUT/PATCH — JSON object, JSON string, or form data.

params.name: pipe
params.description: Optional: pipe the response through a command, e.g. "| jq '.fact'".
